description.value:
You've outfitted your exocortex with a variety of minor distracting features. You gain the following new mod.

  • Debilitating Exocortex (exocortex): Select one of the following conditions: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Deafened], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed]. Creatures damaged by your exocortex must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or gain the chosen condition until the end of their next turn.
